body:
Spy X Famil Inventory Gui Pack

A custom inventory GUI inspired by the system interface from Spy X Family. This pack redesigns the Minecraft inventory with a clean dark theme and subtle glowing details to give a sleek anime-style look.

✨ Features:

Custom inventory design inspired by Spy X Famiy Dark UI with smooth, minimal layout Clean and readable interface Lightweight and simple (inventory only)

🎮 Compatibility:

Minecraft Java Edition Works with most resource packs

📌 Notes:

Only changes the inventory GUI No other menus are modified
